description: The next 10 nights' forecast lows for a city with any frost or near-frost nights, and today's soil temperature (top 7 cm) against the sowing thresholds (hardy seed 10 °C; beans, corn, squash 15 °C). From ECMWF open data, updated twice a day; a regional forecast for the city, not a particular garden. For US cities with a weather station, also this year's actual last and first frost against the average.

city.description: A slug from find_city or a city name, optionally with its region or country.

name: frost_outlook
title: Frost and soil outlook for the next 10 days
